newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Nov 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Nov 12.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy. FRATERNITE MATIN - Air Afrique member states name Sir Harry Tirvengadum of Mauritius as their struggling multinational's new managing director; outgoing chairman and managing director Yves-Roland Billecart says he is looking forward to retirement. LA VOIE - Ivorian Privatisation Committee announcement says that deadline for offers for the San Pedro freight terminal belonging to agro-industrial giant Palmindustrie has been put back from November 18 to December 16. The November 18 date for the Vridi freight terminal remains unchanged. LE JOUR - Chinese private investors visit Ivory Coast; hold talks with government and Ivorian entrepreneurs - Privatisation Committee announcement says it received no bids for a lot grouping agro-industrial giant Palmindustrie's central maintenance workshop and a second workshop.
